query: user-centric agents co-evolve environment and user simulator
text:
1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — The closest and likely intended result. Introduces a meta-agent that jointly adapts the user simulator, environment, rewards, and RL configuration. People: Min Cai and Xi Ye (University of Alberta; Xi Ye also Amii), Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore), Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology), Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher). [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL / SCOPE** — Co-trains an agent with an evolving population of user simulators to prevent overfitting to one simulated user. People: Simon Yu and Weiyan Shi (Northeastern University); Nicholas Tomlin (NYU); Marwa Abdulhai and Sergey Levine (UC Berkeley); Ximing Lu (University of Washington); Derek Chong, Abe Hou, Dilara Soylu, and Christopher D. Manning (Stanford University). [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.12253) · [SCOPE overview](https://simonucl.github.io/blog/2026/scope/)

3. **GenEnv: Difficulty-Aligned Co-Evolution Between LLM Agents and Environment Simulators** — Closely related agent–environment work: an environment model continually generates tasks near the agent’s current capability frontier. People: Jiacheng Guo, Ling Yang, Jiahao Qiu, Ke Shen, and Mengdi Wang (Princeton University); Peter Chen (Columbia University); Qixin Xiao and Xinzhe Juan (University of Michigan); Yinjie Wang (University of Chicago). [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.19682)

4. **UserBench: An Interactive Gym Environment for User-Centric Agents** — Relevant foundation rather than a co-evolution method: an interactive environment with simulated users whose preferences emerge over multiple turns. People: Cheng Qian (Salesforce AI Research and UIUC), Heng Ji (UIUC), and Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Zhiwei Liu, Jianguo Zhang, Haolin Chen, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, and Huan Wang (Salesforce AI Research). [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.22034)

query: meta-agent modifies training environment during multi-turn reinforcement learning
text:
1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — Exact match. A meta-agent modifies the user simulator, environment, rewards, and RL configuration during multi-turn training.  
   **People:** Min Cai (University of Alberta); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher); Xi Ye (University of Alberta, Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute).  
   **URL:** [arXiv paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **EAU full-text HTML** — Searchable version detailing online environment modification, hot-swapping, and cross-run adaptation. Same authors and affiliations as above.  
   **URL:** [arXiv HTML](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.16523)

3. **Independent EAU paper review** — Summarizes the method and flags limitations such as unmatched compute budgets and reliance on a proprietary frontier meta-agent. Same research team as above.  
   **URL:** [Pith review](https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523)
